Northwest China (Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang)
sentences.translation: He's from the northwest, and he's not only very friendly but also very serious about his work.

sentences.text: 秋天是我最喜爱的季节。
sentences.pinyin: qiūtiān shì wǒ zuì xǐài de jìjié
glosses: (before an adjective or verb) to the highest degree; (the) most ...; -est
sentences.translation: Autumn is my favorite season.

sentences.text: 有时候照片看起来很漂亮，但是收到以后才发现颜色和大小都不合适。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shíhòu zhàopiān kàn qǐlái hěn piàoliàng dànshì shōudào yǐhòu cái fāxiàn yánsè hé dàxiǎo dōu bù héshì
glosses: to stand up; to get up
to notice; to become aware of
(joining two nouns) and; together with; with (Taiwan pr. [han4])
sentences.translation: Sometimes the photos look very nice, but only after it arrives do you discover that the color and size are both wrong.

sentences.text: 平时我工作忙，没有时间和儿子一起玩。
sentences.pinyin: píngshí wǒ gōngzuò máng méiyǒu shíjiān hé érzi yìqǐ wán
glosses: (joining two nouns) and; together with; with (Taiwan pr. [han4])
sentences.translation: I'm usually busy with work and don't have time to play with my son.

sentences.text: 这天晚上的月亮特别大，也特别好看。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān wǎnshàng de yuèliàng tèbié dà yě tèbié hǎokàn
sentences.translation: On this night the moon is especially big and especially beautiful.

sentences.text: 我打算明年去美国留学。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián qù měiguó liúxué
sentences.translation: I intend to study abroad in America next year.

sentences.text: 我们家在小区的十二楼，以前他常常坐电梯。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen jiā zài xiǎoqū de shíèr lóu yǐqián tā chángcháng zuò diàntī
glosses: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
sentences.translation: We live on the twelfth floor in our housing complex, and he used to take the elevator.

sentences.text: 现在他下班回来都自己爬上去，周末还去附近的校园里跑步。
sentences.pinyin: xiànzài tā xiàbān huílái dōu zìjǐ pá shàngqù zhōumò hái qù fùjìn de xiàoyuán lǐ pǎobù

to finish work; to get off work
sentences.translation: Now he climbs up on foot whenever he gets home from work, and on weekends he also runs on the nearby campus.

sentences.text: 这一天电梯没有电，他只能自己爬上去。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yī tiān diàntī méiyǒu diàn tā zhǐnéng zìjǐ pá shàngqù
glosses: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
sentences.translation: That day the elevator had no power, so he had to climb up on foot.

sentences.text: 到了草地上，老师给我们买了一个大西瓜，大家在草地上一起吃。

sentences.translation: When we reached the lawn, the teacher bought us a big watermelon, and we all ate it together on the grass.

sentences.pinyin: jī zǒngshì gēn zài wǒ hòumiàn zǒu
glosses: the back; the rear; the last bit
sentences.translation: The chickens always followed me around.

sentences.pinyin: wǒmen zǒu le yí gè duō xiǎoshí dàjiā dōu yòu lèi yòu kě
glosses: (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier)
many; much; more; a lot of
sentences.translation: We walked for over an hour, and everyone got tired and thirsty.

sentences.text: 第二天，我们开始收东西。
sentences.pinyin: dìèr tiān wǒmen kāishǐ shōu dōngxī
sentences.translation: The next day, we started putting things away.

sentences.text: 最后，我们把它们给了住在外地的爷爷。
sentences.pinyin: zuìhòu wǒmen bǎ tāmen gěi le zhù zài wàidì de yéyé
glosses: to live; to reside; to stay
parts of the country other than where one is
sentences.translation: In the end, we gave them to my grandpa, who lives in another town.

sentences.text: 最后我们去附近的宾馆住了一晚。
sentences.pinyin: zuìhòu wǒmen qù fùjìn de bīnguǎn zhù le yī wǎn
glosses: to live; to reside; to stay
sentences.translation: In the end we went to a hotel nearby and stayed the night.

sentences.text: 我说：“新房子不错，您放心吧！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shuō xīn fángzi bùcuò nín fàngxīn ba
glosses: to speak; to talk; to say
you (courteous, as opposed to informal 你[ni3])
sentences.translation: I said, "The new place is nice, don't worry!"

sentences.text: 新房子在五楼，没有电梯，我们只能走楼梯。
sentences.pinyin: xīn fángzi zài wǔ lóu méiyǒu diàntī wǒmen zhǐnéng zǒu lóutī
sentences.translation: The new place is on the fifth floor with no elevator, so we had to take the stairs.

sentences.text: 那时候他个子还矮，现在他比爸爸妈妈都高了。

glosses: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
stature; height; size (of a person or object)
sentences.translation: Back then he was still short, and now he is taller than both his mom and dad.

sentences.text: 这是我们家的一个大难题。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒmen jiā de yí gè dà nàntí
glosses: (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier)
sentences.translation: This was a big problem for our family.

sentences.text: 爷爷说，他现在一共养了十只鸡。
sentences.pinyin: yéyé shuō tā xiànzài yīgòng yǎng le shí zhǐ jī
glosses: to speak; to talk; to say
(third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
sentences.translation: Grandpa says he now keeps ten chickens in all.

sentences.text: 这一天我把手机关机了，只和儿子在一起。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yī tiān wǒ bǎ shǒujī guānjī le zhǐ hé érzi zài yìqǐ
glosses: to turn off (a machine or device)
(joining two nouns) and; together with; with (Taiwan pr. [han4])
sentences.translation: That day I turned my phone off and spent the time with just my son.

sentences.text: 我上初中那年，爸爸从外地带回来两只鸡，我高兴极了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shàng chūzhōng nà nián bàbà cóng wàidì dài huí lái liǎng zhǐ jī wǒ gāoxìng jí le
glosses: junior high school (abbr. for 初級中學/初级中学[chu1 ji2 zhong1 xue2])
parts of the country other than where one is
sentences.translation: The year I started junior high, my dad brought two chickens back from out of town, and I was thrilled.

sentences.text: 我家的大人白天都要上班，所以只有我照顾鸡。

glosses: to want; to need; to ask for
sentences.translation: The grown-ups in my family all worked during the day, so I was the only one looking after the chickens.

sentences.text: 儿子最喜欢看那些鸟，他在那里看了半天，别的动物都不看了。
sentences.pinyin: érzi zuì xǐhuān kàn nàxiē niǎo tā zài nàlǐ kàn le bàntiān bié de dòngwù dōu bù kàn le
glosses: (before an adjective or verb) to the highest degree; (the) most ...; -est
to like; to be fond of
(third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
sentences.translation: My son likes the birds best; he watched them for a long time and didn't look at any other animals after that.

sentences.text: 这里有很多外国的动物，四季都有人来看。
sentences.pinyin: zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō wàiguó de dòngwù sìjì dōu yǒu rén lái kàn
glosses: 很 very; quite + 多 many; much; more; a lot of
four seasons, namely: spring 春[chun1], summer 夏[xia4], autumn 秋[qiu1] and winter 冬[dong1]

sentences.text: 我们常常在草地上聊天儿，吃一些甜的水果。

glosses: erhua variant of 聊天[liao2 tian1]
some; a few; a little; (following an adjective) slightly ...er
sentences.translation: We often chat on the grass and eat some sweet fruit.

sentences.text: 朋友的奶奶不认得我，可是她对我特别好，常常给我做好吃的。

sentences.translation: My friend's grandma didn't know me, but she was especially kind to me and often cooked delicious food for me.

sentences.text: 有时候我也会请假，带孩子去那里玩一个下午。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shíhòu wǒ yě huì qǐngjià dài háizi qù nàlǐ wán yí gè xiàwǔ
glosses: can; to have the skill; to know how to
(classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier)
sentences.translation: Sometimes I also take time off and bring our son there to play for an afternoon.

sentences.text: 南方天气热，到了以后我就换了短裤。
sentences.pinyin: nánfāng tiānqì rè dào le yǐhòu wǒ jiù huàn le duǎnkù
glosses: (after a suppositional clause) in that case; then
sentences.translation: It was hot in the south, so after I arrived I changed into shorts.

sentences.pinyin: dào le chēzhàn wǒ qù jiǎnpiào ránhòu shàng le gāotiě
sentences.translation: At the station, I went through the ticket check and then boarded the high-speed train.

sentences.text: 高铁上有一个小朋友一直在唱，唱得很难听，可是他自己很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: gāotiě shàng yǒu yí gè xiǎo péngyǒu yìzhí zài chàng chàng de hěn nántīng kěshì tā zìjǐ hěn gāoxìng
glosses: (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier)
structural particle: used after a verb (or adjective as main verb), linking it to following phrase indicating effect, degree, possibility etc
(third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
sentences.translation: On the high-speed train a little kid kept singing; it sounded awful, but he was having a great time.

sentences.text: 夏天天气热的时候，他总是穿着短裤在路边跑步。
sentences.pinyin: xiàtiān tiānqì rè de shíhòu tā zǒngshì chuān zhe duǎnkù zài lùbiān pǎobù
glosses: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his
to bore through; to pierce; to perforate
aspect particle indicating action in progress or ongoing state
sentences.translation: In summer when it's hot, he always goes running along the paths in his shorts.
